_doc: Communication templates (CommsManager): message, call, email, encrypted, contract.

c_landlord_notice.subject: Rent
c_landlord_notice.body: Lovely to have you in the building. Popping by later to discuss the arithmetic. — P.O.

c_rook_message.subject: Incoming call
c_rook_message.body: "Mother wants a word. Be nice. She's nice back, mostly."

c_act2.subject: Your name came up
c_act2.body: Three people mentioned you this week. Two were customers, one was an inspector. Congratulations, darling: you exist. — W.

c_voss_email.subject: Clinical outreach partnership (Lyra Biocomp)
c_voss_email.body: Dear Doctor, Lyra Biocomp's Community Neural Wellness programme is expanding into Sublevel 3. We believe you are the ideal partner. I will call in person. Warm regards, C. Voss, Clinical Outreach.

c_static_report.subject: [ENCRYPTED] Case count
c_static_report.body: 41 static-fever cases. 38 had neural work in the last 60 days. 0 investigations opened by the Board. I'm done waiting. — A.M.

c_finale.subject: Come see me
c_finale.body: My hands stopped this morning. Not the tremor. Everything. Come see me while I can still talk. — I.

c_debt_warning.subject: Your tab
c_debt_warning.body: You owe {debt}. At eight percent a day that grows faster than your patients' fingernails. — P.O.

c_staff_raise.subject: About my pay
c_staff_raise.body: {name}: I'm doing harder work than when you hired me. I'd like that to show up on the payroll.

c_informant.subject: [ENCRYPTED] Camera footage
c_informant.body: {name} has been meeting someone from {faction} after closing. Every night this week.

c_contract_dune.subject: Overflow contract
c_contract_dune.body: Partnership terms: my overflow to you, your hard cases to me. Sign by replying.

c_dependency_crisis.subject: About {name}
c_dependency_crisis.body: Somebody from {name}'s block: "They're not sleeping. Their hands won't stop. They keep saying the chrome is talking. You did this, doc. Fix it or stop selling it to them."

fired_grudge.subject: {name} is talking
fired_grudge.body: Word is {name} has been telling corporate security exactly where you keep the unregistered chrome. Being fired made them chatty.
